beats.label: S1 · Six months to slaughter
beats.text: Charlie pitches her redemption hotel to Heaven's Adam and is laughed off. He moves the next Extermination up to six months away.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Sets the ticking clock the whole season runs on and establishes Adam as the antagonist.

beats.label: S1 · The Vees mark the hotel
beats.text: Media overlords Vox, Valentino and Velvette learn Alastor is back and plant Sir Pentious as a spy. Charlie forgives him and he stays for real.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Introduces the Vees as the ongoing corporate enemy and converts Pentious from mole to true believer.

beats.label: S1 · Angel's cage
beats.text: Angel Dust reveals Valentino owns his soul and that he invites abuse hoping to be used up. Husk admits Alastor owns his in the same trap.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Establishes the soul-ownership stakes and the debt Alastor is still under.

beats.label: S1 · Lucifer answers the phone
beats.text: Out of options, Charlie calls her estranged father Lucifer. After clashing with Alastor and each other, they reconcile and he books her a Heaven trial.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Brings Lucifer into the hotel's orbit and sets up the Heaven trip.

beats.label: S1 · The trial that backfires
beats.text: In Heaven, Adam blurts out the Exterminations, splitting Sera from Emily and exposing Vaggie as a former Exorcist. The court rules sinners cannot be redeemed.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Fractures Heaven, outs Vaggie's past, and confirms diplomacy is dead.

beats.label: S1 · Arming the hotel
beats.text: Alastor extracts a future favour from Charlie for the secret to killing angels. Carmilla Carmine trains Vaggie and agrees to supply angelic weapons.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The favour is a live debt into next season and Carmilla becomes the weapons pipeline.

beats.label: S1 · Pentious proves it
beats.text: In the battle Sir Pentious dies charging Adam; Niffty finishes Adam off, Alastor flees wounded. Pentious wakes in Heaven, and Lute orders Lilith back to Hell to end the hotel.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Every S2 thread starts here: proof of redemption, Alastor still owing, Lilith weaponised.

cliffhanger.text: The hotel stands rebuilt and a sinner has provably reached Heaven, but Alastor is still bound to someone, Charlie's mother Lilith has been coerced by Lute into returning to shut the hotel down, and the Vees are gathering to take Hell for themselves.
questions: Who does Alastor still owe, and what happens when that debt is called in?
Will Lilith obey Lute and move against her own daughter?
How will the Vees make their play now that Adam is gone?

characters.name: Charlie Morningstar
characters.line: Lucifer's daughter and hotel founder, now vindicated by Pentious' ascension but still estranged from her missing mother.

characters.name: Vaggie
characters.line: Charlie's girlfriend and outed ex-Exorcist, retrained by Carmilla and back in her wings as the hotel's protector.

characters.name: Alastor
characters.line: The Radio Demon who returned after seven years, holds a called-in favour from Charlie and is still secretly bound to an unnamed owner.

characters.name: Lucifer
characters.line: King of Hell reconciled with Charlie and now backing the hotel, though powerless against sinners themselves.

characters.name: Angel Dust
characters.line: Porn-star sinner whose soul Valentino owns; the hotel's most public test case for redemption.

characters.name: Husk
characters.line: Bartender and fallen overlord whose soul Alastor owns; keeps Angel Dust honest.

characters.name: Vox
characters.line: TV-demon leader of the Vees, publicly humiliated by Alastor and plotting to seize Hell.

characters.name: Valentino
characters.line: Porn overlord of the Vees who legally owns Angel Dust and beats him at will.

characters.name: Velvette
characters.line: Fashion-media Vee, the trio's youngest and most aggressive voice.

characters.name: Lute
characters.line: Adam's second who survived the battle and has blackmailed Lilith into moving against the hotel.

characters.name: Sir Pentious
characters.line: Reformed spy who died sacrificing himself and became the first sinner ever redeemed to Heaven.

characters.name: Lilith
characters.line: Charlie's absent mother, hiding in Heaven for seven years and now ordered by Lute to return and destroy the hotel.

characters.name: Carmilla Carmine
characters.line: Weapons overlord who killed the first Exorcist to protect her daughters and now arms the hotel.

characters.name: Rosie
characters.line: Cannibal Town overlord and Alastor's ally who vouched for Vaggie and pledged her cannibals to the fight.

characters.name: Emily
characters.line: Seraphim who sided with Charlie against Sera over the Exterminations, splitting Heaven's leadership.

characters.name: Sera
characters.line: Senior seraphim who reluctantly sanctioned the Exterminations and now stands exposed for it.

beats.label: S2 · Selling the truth
beats.text: The hotel is mobbed by sinners who think it's a war camp. Charlie tells the public the truth about redemption and almost everyone leaves.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Resets the hotel to a hard sell and hands Vox the narrative vacuum he needs.

beats.label: S2 · Heaven seals itself in
beats.text: Sir Pentious confirms his own redemption but cannot leave Heaven. Sera confesses the Exterminations to God and barricades Heaven shut.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Removes Heaven as an ally and puts Pentious on the inside for the season's endgame.

beats.label: S2 · Vox owns the story
beats.text: In a staged interview Vox airs that Angel Dust is in Hell for killing his father, then edits the hotel footage to bury Charlie's reputation.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Establishes Vox's media war and the personal cost to Angel Dust.

beats.label: S2 · Alastor sells himself to Vox
beats.text: Provoked by Lucifer, Alastor quits the hotel and lets Vox capture him, trading his freedom for Vox's promise not to touch Charlie.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Puts Alastor inside Vox's operation, where he quietly poisons it from within.

beats.label: S2 · Sera lights the fuse
beats.text: Emily and Sera come to Hell to apologise, but Vox spins Sera's admission into a declaration of war. Charlie throws Lucifer out over the botched intervention.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Formalises the Heaven-Hell war and isolates Charlie from her father.

beats.label: S2 · The cannon and the hostage
beats.text: Vox hypnotises Angel Dust as a long-planted spy, uses Charlie's voice to lure Lucifer, and powers Carmilla's cannon with him to blow open Heaven's gates.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The season's central heist: Lucifer captured, Heaven breached, Angel Dust exposed as a mole.

beats.label: S2 · Curtain call
beats.text: Alastor cashes his favour to make Charlie name Vox strongest, freeing himself from both his deals. The overlords blow up the cannon, Valentino and Velvette behead Vox, and Pentious broadcasts his redemption to all of Hell.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Resolves Alastor's debt, kills the Vox era, ends the Exterminations for good.

cliffhanger.text: Heaven has officially ended the Exterminations and agreed to receive redeemed sinners, but Angel Dust has walked back into Valentino's arms out of guilt, Valentino now runs the Vees over a decapitated Vox, and Lilith has finally returned Charlie's call after seven years of silence.
questions: What does Lilith want now that she is finally speaking to her daughter?
Can Angel Dust be pulled back from Valentino a second time?
With Vox reduced to a head, will Valentino's Vees rebuild or splinter?

characters.name: Charlie Morningstar
characters.line: Vindicated hotel owner whose public war with Vox is over and who has just been called by her long-missing mother.

characters.name: Vaggi
characters.line: Formerly Vaggie, now the hotel's official manager after reconciling with Charlie and beating Lute in the final fight.

characters.name: Alastor
characters.line: Free of both his deals for the first time in decades after spending Charlie's favour to escape Vox.

characters.name: Lucifer
characters.line: Rescued from the cannon and reconciling with Charlie after being thrown out for undermining her.

characters.name: Angel Dust
characters.line: Exposed as Vox's hypnotised spy; has left the hotel and returned to Valentino out of shame.

characters.name: Sir Pentious
characters.line: Redeemed sinner in Heaven who broadcast proof of his salvation to all of Hell, ending the Extermination policy.

characters.name: Vox
characters.line: Decapitated but alive after Valentino and Velvette turned on him mid-broadcast; no longer leads the Vees.

characters.name: Valentino
characters.line: New head of the Vees, still owns Angel Dust, and has just taken him back.

characters.name: Velvette
characters.line: Sided with Valentino against Vox and shares the top of the Vees with him.

characters.name: Lute
characters.line: Beaten by Vaggi and pulled off her by Abel; her Extermination crusade is officially over.

characters.name: Emily
characters.line: Seraphim who lost a wing helping Hell and now represents Heaven's opening to redeemed sinners.

characters.name: Sera
characters.line: Publicly confessed the Exterminations and reluctantly authorised the peace.

characters.name: Abel
characters.line: Adam's son and Heaven's new army chief, siding with Emily's peace over Lute's revenge.

characters.name: Carmilla Carmine
characters.line: Built Vox's cannon under duress and helped destroy it once Lucifer was inside.

characters.name: Baxter
characters.line: Mad-scientist sinner who joined the hotel studying redemption and hacked Vox's broadcast.

characters.name: Cherri Bomb
characters.line: Sir Pentious' old rival and Angel Dust's friend, now a full resident of the hotel.

characters.name: Lilith
characters.line: Charlie's mother, finally breaking seven-plus years of silence with a phone call.
